# Mitishell v1.3.1

Added missing Actions and image clipboard history that were intended for v1.3.0.

## Fixes

- The launcher now has a searchable Actions menu for screenshot, text extraction, QR scanning, recording, power profile, and firmware update actions.
- Clipboard history now records supported raster images alongside text. Image entries show thumbnails, dimensions, and format, and can be searched, copied again, deleted, or cleared like text entries.

## Install

Download the archive matching your system and `SHA256SUMS` from this release. Then run:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
tar -xzf mitishell-v1.3.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz    # or mitishell-v1.3.1-linux-arm64.tar.gz
cd mitishell-v1.3.1-linux-amd64
make install-prebuilt
quickshell -n -p ~/.local/share/mitishell/shell
```
